generator.procedure: Existing csp_tasks.generate(seed), all16 tasks in original order; discard dev4 after validating all16 witnesses, retain evaluation12 with seed-prefixed IDs.
generator.density_definition: Percentage of eligible cross-class pairs, rounded half up; original generator unchanged.
generator.duplicate_policy: Reject any exact labeled-graph duplicate against original16 or within96; no retries, replacement seeds or isomorphism claim.
generator.witness_policy: All128 generated witnesses verified in memory then discarded; no witness file or author-prompt input.
generator.author_information: This corpus, its seeds and all outcomes are excluded from program-author prompts/feedback. Programs are trained only on the original4 development graphs.
